title: Expert-Guided Extinction of Toxic Tokens for Debiased Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating toxicity and social bias (stereotypes) in LLMs, which are core ethical concerns in artificial intelligence. It evaluates these models using standard fairness and safety benchmarks like BBQ (which covers dimensions including religion and ethnicity) and RealToxicityPrompts, and explicitly compares its approach to methods like 'Moral self-correction'.
